title: API tokens and login providers
routing: Is this about an API key or a login provider: minting a token (createToken and the create-token routes), its owner kind (TokenOwnerModel: User, Organization, OrganizationUser, Space, SpaceUser), the SHA-256 keyHash shown once, how tokenAuthMiddleware reads Bearer or ?token= and loadTokenContext signs it in (10-minute row cache, the owner must exist, lastUsedAt on a cache miss), the TokensPage; or which sign-in options exist: platform providers from env vars (getPlatformProviders) vs an organization's AuthProvider rows with encrypted secrets (authProviderReadMany, organizationReadAuthProvider, organizationCreateAuthProvider, authProviderUpdate / authProviderDelete, OrganizationAuthProvidersPage, useAuthProviders), SAML status? The sign-in handshake, user JWTs and OAuth are `authentication`.
